title: Slide into the trial
label: A call to action built from a single short water slide. Under the heading, one rider waits on a small tower and gives a little bob. The water switches on and lights the flume one segment at a time, each segment's lamp turning on as it fills. The rider slides down, flies off the lip and splashes into the landing pool, which is a button labelled Start your free trial; the button presses in and sends out one pulse. The water drains segment by segment and the next rider climbs the ladder to wait at the top.
heading:
See where your
next visitor lands.
sub: Add one snippet and see who makes it through every step of your funnel.
